guitar.evidence: Collective Soul's guitarists (Ed Roland, Ross Childress, later Jesse Triplett) have used Gibson Les Pauls/SGs typical of 90s alt-rock, but no singularly iconic documented instrument.

tone.target: jangly compressed clean with edge-of-breakup shimmer
tone.profile: jangly compressed clean with edge-of-breakup shimmer
tone.summary: A compressed signal chain utilizing a Boost/Comp for attack, followed by a clean British amp model (UK 45) paired with a bright cab, enhanced by Chorus and subtle Room reverb.
